capabilities: Register local files into asset groups without copying them into the vault
Insert assets into notes as id-based code blocks
Embed images, audio, and video, or link PDFs and Office files as title cards
Edit asset metadata and relocate or bulk-fix moved file paths
Export a group's notes and assets to a folder with catalog and README files
extras: Desktop only (Electron dialogs and Node file access); also installable via BRAT before community-plugin approval; README is provided in English and Korean.
problem: Obsidian embeds require copying files into the vault with fixed paths, so referencing research files kept on the computer breaks when they move or when many notes share them.

relations.evidence: works with Obsidian print and companions such as Beautiful PDF

summary: Asset manager that links local files (photos, figures, spreadsheets, PDFs) into shared asset groups and inserts them into notes by id.
